features.t: Azure Backup for AKS
x: Azure Backup for AKS (backup vault, backup extension, backup instances for a cluster) is not modelled; the Backup page shows an honest Not simulated panel.

features.t: Diagnose and solve problems, Tasks
x: Diagnose and solve problems runs Microsoft's fleet-wide diagnostics against telemetry Vyomi never collects, and Tasks links to Azure Automation / Logic Apps backends that no local simulator has; the console shows an honest Not simulated panel for both.

features.t: Capacity gauge
x: The capacity gauge is not modelled: Vyomi has no gateway load to measure.

features.t: Wiring a new service to Log Analytics, Application Insights or Defender for APIs at create time
x: These create-wizard checkboxes provision separate monitoring and security resources in real Azure; Vyomi does not model that provisioning (create the Log Analytics workspace / Application Insights component separately and link it from the service).

features.t: Diagnose and solve problems, Tasks
x: Diagnose and solve problems runs Microsoft's fleet-wide diagnostics against telemetry Vyomi never collects, and Tasks links to Azure Automation / Logic Apps backends that no local simulator has; the console shows an honest Not simulated panel for both.

features.t: Create wizard: linked database and secure unique default hostname
x: Provisioning a linked database from the Web App wizard is not modelled (create the database in its own service). 'Secure unique default hostname' has no effect: Vyomi always uses the exact name you choose, there is no name-collision suffix.

features.t: Diagnose and solve problems, Tasks
x: Diagnose and solve problems runs Microsoft's fleet-wide diagnostics against telemetry Vyomi never collects, and Tasks links to Azure Automation / Logic Apps backends that no local simulator has; the console shows an honest Not simulated panel for both.

features.t: Diagnose and solve problems, Tasks, Support + Troubleshooting
x: Diagnose and solve problems runs Microsoft's fleet-wide diagnostics against telemetry Vyomi never collects, and Tasks links to Azure Automation / Logic Apps backends that no local simulator has; the console shows an honest Not simulated panel for both. Support + Troubleshooting (the shared support-request panel, azure.common.support) is not wired into the Cosmos DB blade.

features.t: Azure Function, Power BI and Data Migration tool integrations
x: These integration pages (Azure Function trigger wizard, Power BI, Azure Data Migration Service) need separate Azure products that Vyomi does not run; the blade shows an honest Not simulated panel for each. Use Data Explorer and the native Cosmos SDK instead.

features.t: Browse and Scale blades for a single container
x: The standalone Browse and Scale blades are not modelled: select the container in Data Explorer (azure.cosmos.data_explorer) and use account-level throughput (azure.cosmos.scale_ru) instead.

features.t: BitLocker keys
x: BitLocker recovery key escrow needs real disk encryption on real hardware, which Vyomi's software simulation does not have.

features.t: Entra grid toolbar actions (bulk operations, per-user MFA, columns, export settings, preview features, troubleshoot, feedback)
x: Toolbar actions on the Entra user, group, application, role and device grids that are not modelled: inline bulk edit, CSV bulk operations, per-user MFA, Export Data Settings, Troubleshoot / Diagnose and solve problems, Columns, Download (Export), Preview features and info, and Got feedback. Delete custom role is available from the grid's Delete command.

features.t: Diagnose and solve problems, Tasks
x: Diagnose and solve problems runs Microsoft's fleet-wide diagnostics against telemetry Vyomi never collects, and Tasks links to Azure Automation / Logic Apps backends that no local simulator has; the console shows an honest Not simulated panel for both.

features.t: Manage deleted keys and secrets (recover / purge)
x: The Manage deleted keys / Manage deleted secrets pages (soft-delete recover and purge) are not modelled; backup and restore of a key or secret (azure.keyvaults.backup_restore) are real.

features.t: Enable access for VMs, ARM template deployment and disk encryption
x: Enabling Key Vault access for virtual machines, ARM template deployment and disk encryption is not modelled: Vyomi does not run those services' Key Vault integrations, so the three access-configuration flags are not honoured.

features.t: Integrations (Stream Analytics, Data Sync, Fabric mirroring, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI)
x: These integration pages need separate Azure products (Stream Analytics, SQL Data Sync, Microsoft Fabric, the Power Platform) that Vyomi does not run; the blade shows an honest Not simulated panel for each.

features.t: Database watcher
x: Database watcher (Microsoft.DatabaseWatcher: continuous collection of database telemetry into Data Explorer) is not modelled.

features.t: Diagnose and solve problems, Tasks, external SQL client
x: Diagnose and solve problems runs Microsoft's fleet-wide diagnostics against telemetry Vyomi never collects, and Tasks links to Azure Automation / Logic Apps backends that no local simulator has; the console shows an honest Not simulated panel for both. Launching an external SQL client (SSMS, Azure Data Studio) from the portal is not modelled; connect to the database with any client directly or use the Query editor.

features.t: Always Encrypted
x: Always Encrypted (column master keys and client-side column encryption) is not modelled; Transparent data encryption is a separate, real-as-config page (azure.sql.transparent_data_encryption).

features.t: Private endpoint connections
x: Private endpoint connections on the storage account are not modelled in the Networking page (the Private Endpoint resource itself is a Network service object).

features.t: Force delete, Resource group insights, Tasks
x: Force delete of VMs and scale sets inside a group, Resource group insights and Tasks (Azure Automation / Logic Apps) are not modelled; plain delete of the group and of its resources is real (azure.resourcegroups.rg.crud).

features.t: Container Registry support and troubleshooting pages
x: Diagnose and solve problems, Tasks-style automation and the other support pages of the registry blade have no backend: Vyomi collects none of the telemetry Microsoft's fleet-wide diagnostics run against. The console shows an honest Not simulated panel.
